_comment: Per-implementation adapter config for the Bifrost meta test harness.
Each adapter declares how to drive one Shen port. Bifrost substitutes:
{bin}  -> the resolved launcher binary (after env-var / default resolution)
{expr} -> a Shen expression string (for eval mode)
{file} -> an absolute path to a .shen program (for script mode)
Templates are argv lists (NOT shell strings): no quoting/word-splitting games.
Path resolution order for each impl's binary:
1. the env var named in 'env'
2. the first existing path in 'default_paths'
If none resolve, the impl is SKIPPED and reported (never a hard error).
'eval'  : argv template that evaluates {expr} and prints its value to stdout.
'script': argv template that runs the .shen program at {file} to stdout.
'version': argv template that prints the kernel version banner to stdout.
If absent, Bifrost falls back to eval of (version).
'repl'  : argv template that starts the interactive REPL (fed EOF on stdin).
'hush_writes_file': KNOWN cross-impl divergence. true  = `pr` to a file
stream still writes even under -q/*hush*; false = -q silences it
(zero-byte file). Documented, NOT asserted as agreement.
Note: shen-cl REQUIRES -q for clean eval/repl output; shen-rust/shen-lua
MUST omit -q for normal cases or `pr` output is silenced.
CROSS-PLATFORM: launcher paths/templates are POSIX-shaped by default.
On Windows, extensionless default_paths also match shen.exe/.cmd/.bat
(PATHEXT), and a .bat/.cmd/.sh launcher is auto-wrapped (cmd /c, sh).
Per-OS specifics go in an optional 'os_overrides' block per adapter,
keyed by sys.platform ('win32'/'darwin'/'linux'); the matching block is
shallow-merged over the adapter. See _os_overrides_example below. As
always, $BIFROST_<IMPL> overrides the launcher path on any OS.

_doc: Illustrative ONLY (key starts with _ so it is ignored at load). Copy the
'os_overrides' block into a real adapter and adjust. Example: on Windows,
drive shen-lua by invoking luajit explicitly instead of the POSIX shell
wrapper, and point default_paths at the repo's Lua entrypoint.

shen-cl._install_note: Default method git-build (so a fork can be built). git remote / ref overridable via --git/--ref or $BIFROST_SHEN_CL_GIT / _REF; default is the pyrex41 fork. `--method brew` uses the 'shen-cl' Homebrew formula instead. The launcher itself can point at any prebuilt fork binary via $BIFROST_SHEN_CL. BOOTSTRAP: a fresh clone has no kernel/ or compiled/ tree, so before `make build-sbcl` you must run `make fetch` (or scripts/assemble-tarver-kernel.sh) and then `make precompile SHEN=<path to any working Shen launcher, e.g. a built shen-go>` -- precompiling the kernel requires an already-working Shen. `bifrost install shen-cl` runs only the final build step, so on a first-ever install do the fetch+precompile once by hand (see the shen-cl README).
shen-cl._repl_note: Bare {bin} (no args) enters the REPL. Do NOT pass -q here: -q is only valid after the eval/script subcommand; as a bare first arg shen-cl rejects it ('Invalid argument: -q') and exits before the REPL starts — which made the stdin-eof case pass spuriously without ever testing EOF.

shen-go._install_note: git-build clones the pyrex41 fork: it carries the standard launcher CLI (eval/script/--version, kernel 41.2) that Bifrost drives. Upstream tiancaiamao/shen-go lacks those subcommands (S41.1) and does not exit on stdin EOF, so it cannot be driven by Bifrost.

shen-lua._install_note: git-build clones the repo; bin/shen runs straight from the checkout (KLambda is compiled on first boot and cached -- the build step just warms that cache). Needs luajit at runtime. Alternative: `--method luarocks` installs the published 'shen' rock to /usr/local/bin/shen; rock 0.10.0-1+ bundles kernel 41.2 (the older 0.9.0-1 was 41.1 -- see pyrex41/shen-lua#38).
shen-lua._version_note: shen-lua has no --version flag; Bifrost falls back to eval of (version).

ShenScript._install_note: git-build clones the pyrex41 fork and runs `npm install` + `npm run build-kernel` (renders lib/kernel.js). The launcher is bin/shen.js run under node; point $BIFROST_SHENSCRIPT at it (or at another fork's bin/shen.js). The published npm package 'shen-script' is a library only (no bin/shen.js launcher, no bin entry), so `npm install -g` cannot produce a launcher.

shen-scheme._install_note: Homebrew formula 'shen-scheme' (also GitHub release binaries). git-build alternative: --method git-build (needs make + a C compiler; auto-fetches Chez 10.3).
shen-scheme._note: Chez Scheme port by tizoc (Bruno Deferrari). Binary finds its boot file (lib/shen-scheme/shen.boot) relative to the executable, so cwd-independent. -q maps to --quiet -> (set *hush* true), which silences stdout (so it is NOT passed for normal eval/script cases); file-stream pr still writes under -q. Converged with the 41.2 reference ports on all bifrost cases (kernel 41.2; clean stdin-EOF exit; hush gates stdout only).

shen-julia._install_note: git-build: clone + Pkg.instantiate (deps). No sysimage by default (~12s boot); build one with `julia --project=. bin/build_sysimage.jl` and point $SHEN_JULIA_SYSIMAGE at it to cut startup.
shen-julia._note: Julia port (shen-julia), 41.2 kernel. The bin/shen wrapper drives the kernel's standard launcher (shen.x.launcher.main from extension-launcher.kl) -- same CLI surface as shen-go/shen-rust/ShenScript. Boots ~12s per invocation (no sysimage yet; set $SHEN_JULIA_SYSIMAGE to a prebuilt ShenJulia.sys to cut that); well within the 60s timeout. Do NOT pass -q for normal eval/script cases: -q sets *hush* which silences stdout (the value would not print). A host-side pr override makes *hush* gate ONLY stdout, never an explicit file stream, so it converges with the hardened hush-file-write case (writes). REPL exits cleanly on stdin EOF via a host-side readline loop.

shen-swift._install_note: git-build: clone + `swift build -c release` (Swift 6+ toolchain; macOS or Linux with the open-source toolchain). Self-contained -- the 41.2 .kl kernel ships inside the SwiftPM resource bundle, no separate kernel checkout needed.
shen-swift._note: Swift port (shen-swift), 41.2 kernel, built from scratch as a tree-walking KLambda interpreter targeting iOS as well as macOS (no JIT/codegen -- runs inside the iOS sandbox). Drives the kernel's standard launcher (shen.x.launcher.main from extension-launcher.kl) -- same CLI surface as shen-go/shen-rust/shen-julia/ShenScript. Boots the kernel (~1-2.7s release) on every invocation; passes the 41.2 kernel test suite 35/35 groups. A host-side pr override makes *hush* gate ONLY stdout, never an explicit file stream, so -q silences the printed value but file writes still happen (hush_writes_file=true) -- this also lets shen-swift host ratatoskr shakes, which run under -q. -q is NOT passed for normal eval/script cases (it would suppress the value). REPL exits cleanly on stdin EOF (getchar -> exit).

shen-inets._note: shen-inets (HVM3 interaction-net port). The launcher compiles each eval/script request as a tiny Shen source program, tree-shakes it with ratatoskr, and runs the cached compiled HVM artifact. It is intentionally not a runtime reader/eval implementation: a manifest with needs-eval=true exits 3, which bifrost records as a capability SKIP. version is a static 41.2 banner and repl provides the corpus-required clean stdin-EOF exit.
